sections.name: CaseApplicationService
sections.title: Tests for case loading, creation and seeding
sections.what: Checks that demo cases load with the expected names and parcel numbers, that the two demo cases differ, that a missing case returns nothing, that a new case saves and reloads, that bad or real-looking input is rejected, that clearly labelled Hindi synthetic text is accepted, and that seeded documents and control records are correct.
sections.why: Likely reason: these are the rules the demo depends on, including rejecting anything that looks like a real case.
sections.watch_out: The checks share one database without a reset, so an earlier check can change the data a later check sees.

summary: Tests that loading, creating and seeding demo cases behave as expected, including the rules for accepted input.
purpose: Protects the behaviour of case data and demo seed records.
why: Reason not stated in the code. Likely to keep the demo data correct and to keep fake-looking real data out.
how: One group of checks uses a single shared service and checks each behaviour in turn, from loading demo cases to creating new ones and checking seeded documents.
inputs: The case service and document service.
outputs: Pass or fail results from the test runner.
risks: The checks share one database with no reset between tests, so results can depend on test order. Expected values such as names and parcel numbers are written directly into the tests.
debug: Run the test file alone to see whether a failure depends on another test. Compare the failing expected value with the seed data in the case service.
